authored_frame: measured native stamp-space before inverse resource projection
native_state_wiring: preserved external contract; ordinal authored damage compositions only

profile_provenance.reviewed_against: actual recipe tags/geometry formulas, current family_states.py and state_geometry.py; no Blender execution
profile_provenance.native_dependency_policy: retained native rigs/graphs/markers/conditional attachments stay outside scratch fracture; no new motion, HP values or gameplay tier
profile_provenance.status: source-reviewed draft; Boolean topology, support after fracture, normal/UV seams and game-camera progression require generated review
profile_provenance.read_only_verification: All exact body/group/native identities, real support-plane scatter corners/fallen-piece vertices, progressive positive cutter-box overlaps and targeting exclusions checked offline.
profile_provenance.revision: Pointed-hood-v3: genuine family-local pointed iwan apertures, coherent pointed trim/vaults, original seated receding royal-entrance muqarnas semi-dome; v2 atlas/proportion/clerestory inputs retained.

adapter_requirements: preserve_custom_source_uv through all state/LOD modifiers; never blanket-retile fracture regions
body.fracture_surface_overrides used by subtract/heavy-cut/ruin cap projection so glazed cuts expose masonry

A1.review_status: recipe-reviewed coordinates/groups; actual generated damage/ruins/LODs uninspected
A1.resource_age_label_qualification: existing resource label only; Shah labels are not historical mosque ages

damage.failure_programme: A warm low winter-hall roof corner fails first, so early damage preserves Royal Mosque recognition; severe state loses the principal crown and unequal portal/minaret tops with the supporting hall roofs.
progression_review: 1: winter-hall coping/roof-edge ceramic-and-masonry spall
2: expanded low roof-corner hole with exposed core
3: nested corner breach cuts into the connected shallow bay cover; inspect a real irregular hole rather than separated dome buttons
4: clear loss through winter-hall roof and upper wall; main turquoise crown remains supported
5: sanctuary backing/iwans and minaret shafts remain unevenly, principal dome/finial and subordinate roofs are gone; retain four-iwan/court/turned-entry traces
damage.debris_grounding_basis: Outer earthen strip bottom .08 at X3.60..4.95, forward of winter hall and outside main-court paving; do not float this scatter on .116 court Z.
damage.support_review: Heavy cap explicitly removes every main_dome part/finial, clips sanctuary and portal/minaret groups, and removes owner/detail fittings attached to lost tops. Native bench/tree/layout dependencies stay external. New connected roof field and all high clerestory/frame parts retain their original structural groups, so every clipped upper roof/frame is removed with its bearing programme. V3 muqarnas spring band, side seats, backing and cells share AngledRoyalPortal failure group, so its existing heavy cap cuts all together; no independent hanging ornament group.

fallen_slabs.grounding_basis: horizontal fragment bottom at authored support Z=0.11599999999999999
horizontal fragment bottom at authored support Z=0.11599999999999999
horizontal fragment bottom at authored support Z=0.11599999999999999
fallen_slabs.interpretation: exposed masonry backside of the displaced qibla tile-bearing slab; the other small dome fragment retains fixed turquoise glaze

ruins.composition_review: The paved court remains legible among four unequal iwan foundations, truncated minaret bases and the angled portal/vestibule trace; masonry fragments carry restrained fixed glaze, not timber-house roof clutter.
ruins.grounding_review: Rubble and three fragments bottom .116 on retained MainCourtPaving; rectangle stays clear of court-edge iwan/piers. Early damage scatter instead uses separate .08 soil. No entire minaret is invented as a square fallen timber beam.
ruins.fallen_member_policy: No timber roof members are modeled in masonry dome/iwans; leave fallen_members empty and use small editable masonry/glazed slabs instead.
ruins.source_dating: Completed seventeenth-century Royal Mosque interpretation; resource labels A1..A4 do not imply historic early mosque tiers.

lod_design_notes.implementation: design only; generic Decimate must preserve custom UVs and may need purpose-built profile proxies
required_proxy_design: Retain four real iwans, the large negative court, sanctuary room, angled portal/vestibule, both minaret pairs and low winter-hall rhythm.
Main dome 48 longitude sectors should reduce to32/24, preserving maximum radius/neck/crown and a true per-loop longitude seam; profile rings may reduce only after silhouette comparison.
Minarets24 sectors may reduce to16/12; retain balcony and cap stages, smooth curved shafts, flat ledges/caps. Never retile fixed blue glaze or brick fracture UVs.

Reduce coherent arch/vault profiles without closing their apertures; connected shallow roof fields may coarsen12x30 to about8x15/6x10 only while preserving maximum crowns, seated boundaries and actual surviving damage holes.
Clipped roof/dome/arch proxies must use surviving source topology; never regenerate an intact dome, arch crown or roof across damage gaps.

Royal portal hood is one continuous masonry-backed five-tier semi-dome with40 individually editable closed tile cells. Any damaged LOD must retain the actual surviving hood/cell boundaries and original brick cut UVs; never repopulate missing tiers or restore a full pointed arch across a breach.
lod_design_notes.actual_ratios: unverified; no acceptance by sector arithmetic alone
